text: {"table": {"name": "budget", "purpose": "Budget line items for club/organization events: each row is a budget category (e.g. Food, Advertisement) allocated to a specific event, tracking the allocated amount, amount spent, and remaining amount, plus a status. Referenced by expense records that draw against these budget lines."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "budget_id", "description": "Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for the budget line item. Referenced by expense.col_007, linking expenses to their budget line.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "category", "name": "category", "description": "Budget category/line item name, e.g. Food, Advertisement, Parking, Speaker Gifts, Club T-Shirts.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "numeric", "name": "amount_spent", "description": "Amount already spent against this budget line (currency, likely USD). Zero for open/planning items; grows as expenses are recorded. In samples, spent + remaining equals the allocated total.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "numeric", "name": "amount_remaining", "description": "Remaining balance of the budget line (currency). Equals allocated total minus spent; can be negative (min -24.25) when overspent. Sample values like 0.41/0.75 suggest cents-level tracking.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "numeric", "name": "amount_allocated", "description": "Total amount allocated to the budget line (currency, whole dollars). Consistent with spent + remaining in sample rows (e.g. 67.81 + 7.19 = 75).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "category", "name": "status", "description": "Lifecycle status of the budget line: Planning, Open, or Closed.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "event_id", "description": "Foreign key to event.col_001; the event this budget line belongs to. Each event has several budget lines (many_to_one).", "status": "resolved"}}}
